description: The zero function is eventually at most the function equal to one on even inputs and zero on odd inputs. The reverse eventual inequality fails, and strict eventual inequality from zero also fails.

      ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FiniteErrors.EventuallyLT (fun x => 0) fun n => if n % 2 = 0 then 1 else 0
